items.title: Conversation header is a continuous Messenger-style surface
items.precondition: Sign in with access to at least one conversation; set a custom chat theme if one is available.
steps: Open /messages/:conversationId with the default chat theme at a normal desktop width.
Inspect the boundary between the profile/action header and the messages; confirm there is no horizontal divider or visible color/gradient seam.
Confirm the Search, Customize chat theme, and Conversation options controls remain visible and their shared action pill still has its border.
Confirm the composer still has its own top separator.
Repeat with one selected solid custom chat theme and one selected gradient custom chat theme at a narrow/mobile viewport width.
Scroll the gradient-themed message pane and confirm its background remains continuous with the header.
items.expected: The conversation header and thread form one continuous surface in default, solid custom, and gradient custom themes. All controls, the action-pill border, message bubbles, and composer separator remain unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: user tested the default and selected custom conversation themes and confirmed the Messenger-style continuous surface is correct.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: All commands exit successfully with no errors caused by the divider removal.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, lint, and build completed successfully after the initial divider removal and again after the Rev 2 continuous-surface refinement.
items.notes: Lint emitted six pre-existing warnings in MessageQuoteStrip, PostPhotoCommentsPage, AuthContext, ThemeContext, and PostDetailPage. Vite emitted its pre-existing large-chunk advisory.
